projects.name: xrooster
projects.summary: An unofficial schedule app for Android and iOS.
projects.description:
Our school used an app called Eduarte for schedules, but it was ugly, hard to log in and missed features we wanted.

So me and a friend decided we should try to build our own app.
We found that Eduarte didn't use any api's but used server side rendereing instead. But we found that they got their schedule from another site called Xedule, and they did have undocumented api's.

With some browser devtools and a hacky login system it worked.


While working on this project I also found a security vulnerability that allowed every student to see other students schedules and grades by just having their student email, which was very easy to find in teams.

I reported this to the school and they fixed it in a couple of days.
